name: Mediaelch
tagline: A MediaManager for Kodi. Information about Movies, TV Shows, Concerts and Music are stored as nfo files. Fanarts are downloaded automatically from fanart. Tv. Using the nfo generator, MediaElch can be used with other MediaCenters as well.
description: MediaElch is a MediaManager for Kodi. Information about Movies, TV Shows, Concerts and Music are stored as nfo files. Fanarts are downloaded automatically from fanart.tv. Using the nfo generator, MediaElch can be used with other MediaCenters as well.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/mediaelch:2.12.0@sha256:62548eba071dfeaa2185bf035bd8d133ac2e68d76e9fed0a8e3fbe47a38262e3
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
